product: Rear lamp for M1 passenger cars: an exterior lighting and signalling module that combines rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions plus a rear retro-reflector behind one outer lens in a single housing. The image shows a left/right-side lamp in two views: an internal view without lens, and an external view with the lens.
vehicle_categories: M1 (passenger car); the spec states that UNECE lighting regulations apply across M and N categories
mounting: Rear of the vehicle (exterior rear lamp). The exact position, height and lateral spacing are not stated. The image shows a handed lamp (one side of the vehicle) with a wraparound-style outline.
functions: rear position lamp (presence/visibility) - category not stated (R or R1/R2 unknown)
stop lamp (braking indication) - category not stated (S1/S2 unknown)
rear retro-reflector (passive conspicuity) - class not stated (IA/IB unknown)
outer lens: light transmission and red colour definition
components: Outer lens - PMMA, red-tinted, UV-stabilised - transmits light, defines colour, protects interior
Housing - PP or ASA/PC - holds all parts, mounts to vehicle
Reflector surface - PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating - redirects LED light
Retro-reflector - PMMA, molded prism optics - passive rear retro-reflection
Light source - LED modules on PCB - light emission for position, stop and reversing functions
Seal / gasket - TPE or silicone - seals lens/housing and the lamp to the body
Fasteners / clips - PA, POM or steel - assembly and mounting
Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp - functional sub-assemblies (listed as main parts)
configuration: Single housing and single outer lens for several functions: grouped/combined lamp with position, stop, reversing and retro-reflector; which functions are combined or reciprocally incorporated is not specified
Light-source technology: LED modules on PCB; replaceable or non-replaceable not stated
